title: feat(spec)!: retire kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts whole — the upgrade plan, diff, snapshot and rollback model nothing implemented (ADR-0049)
body:
Fixes #25608
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Ruling-ref: 6259332195 (ruling A on #24443, item 3); triage first grade 6382810541

Retires `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` whole — the package upgrade plan, metadata diff, impact level, pre-upgrade snapshot, upgrade and rollback request/response pairs and the phase vocabulary — together with the four `IPackageService` members that returned them (`planUpgrade`, `upgrade`, `rollback`, `getSnapshot`) and their three input interfaces, and the `plan` member of `PackageUpgradeResponse.data`. ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, route 3 (whole-def removal). Nothing ever implemented, served or read any of it.

The two governed sentences (ADR-0126 about `:321`, and the ADR-0138 D5 sentence ruling A `6386464761` orders) ride their own draft PR, #25716, which merges after this one.

## Ruling executed (quoted, not re-ruled)

Ruling `6259332195` on #24443, letter A, maintainer 「其他同意」, item 3: "**Retired:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` (plan, diff, conflict, snapshot, rollback; zero runtime consumers), with its ADR-0087 conversion." Triage `6382810541`: done directly in 18.x with no retirement stage.

## Premise re-measured (every zero beside a lit control)

| reading | tree | retired names (29) + `planUpgrade` + the module specifier | control |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| objectstack, outside `packages/spec`, CHANGELOGs excluded | base `47af3dde42` | 0 code files: 3 generated reference pages + `references/kernel/meta.json`, `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, one ADR-0126 sentence | the same pattern hits 17 files inside `packages/spec` |
| objectui `main` | `a3c0da9` | 0 files | `@objectstack/spec`: 2123 files |
| objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` | `2958f17e9c` | 0 files | `@objectstack/spec`: 2131 files |
| hotcrm `main` | `a4b3560` | 0 files | `@objectstack/spec`: 293 files |
| providers | base | nothing implements `IPackageService` | — |

The card's inventory held, with two additions it did not list: `src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` used `MetadataChangeType` as its "live near-namesake" must-survive control (its only reader was the retired module itself; the control is now `BreakingChange`), and the contract lost **four** members and three input interfaces, not two — `rollback` and `getSnapshot` returned the retired `RollbackPackageResponse` / `UpgradeSnapshot` as well.

## Why no D2 conversion and no tombstone

None of the ten shapes is a stack collection member or a metadata type, so there is no authored document a D2 conversion could rewrite and no carrier key a `retiredKey()` tombstone could sit on. The ruling's "ADR-0087 conversion" is therefore the ledger record, exactly as for the export-job and change-management whole-family retirements: ten `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entries (which the manifest-deletion gate reads), one D3 semantic entry `kernel-package-upgrade-family-retired`, and one `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment. The `UpgradePlan.estimatedDuration` tombstone's `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entry and the D3 entry `kernel-package-lifecycle-durations-unit-in-key` stay as history (pinned). `PackageUpgradeResponse.data` is a non-strict object bound to no route, so its `plan` leaves without a tombstone (route 3: nothing parses it); a pin asserts a stray `plan` is stripped.

## What changed

- **Removed:** `src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` and its test; the re-export in `src/kernel/index.ts` (a comment block stays in its place naming the retirement); the upgrade section of `src/contracts/package-service.ts` and its test cases; `plan` in `src/api/package-api.zod.ts`.
- **Registered:** `src/migrations/entries/retired-defs/18.kernel__*.ts` ×10, `src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.kernel-package-upgrade-family-retired.ts`, a `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment in `src/migrations/registry.ts.template`.
- **Pinned:** `src/kernel/package-upgrade-family-retirement.test.ts` (listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`; its walk radius is the one already declared for `@objectstack/spec` in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`): zero holders on every public entry, runtime namespaces, the four contract members absent at the type level with a lit control, `plan` absent from the shape, module gone from disk and unimported, shards clean, ledger wired with no D2 conversion, and tree-scoped absence across `packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `scripts`.
- **Generated (regenerated, not hand-typed):** `json-schema.manifest/kernel.json` (−10, deleted deliberately as the manifest-deletion gate requires), `authorable-surface/kernel.json` (−48, the whole-def route; check (c) re-proved it against the git base), `authorable-defaults/kernel.json`, `api-surface/{kernel,contracts}.json`, `declaration-map/kernel.json`, `export-origins/{kernel,contracts}.json`, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (two entries and their header totals), the strictness-ledger counts, and `content/docs/references/**` (the `package-upgrade` page is gone).
- **Count pins that follow the module:** `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` 790 → 786 (four isomorphic pins and the `M92` import), `scripts/file-description.test.ts` 31 → 30 level-1 openers, `llms.txt` 206 → 205 schemas / kernel 31 → 30, `quick-reference.mdx` kernel 30 → 29.
- **Hand-written docs made false by the diff:** `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` described a package-upgrade lifecycle (pre-check, plan, snapshot, …) and linked the removed page; it now says what the platform serves — a re-install with `overwrite: true` and the commit rollback — and links Package Management in the Metadata API.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/25608-retire-package-upgrade.md`, `minor` (launch-window convention) with the BREAKING banner, the FROM → TO table, both declaration lines and `registered kernel-package-upgrade-family-retired`.

## Tests and gates

All readings below are at head `3e7b204be7` (after merging `origin/main` `c61f75d10f` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, a full `turbo run build` and `@objectstack/spec` `build` + `check:generated`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, exit codes captured before any pipe.

| command | result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` | exit 1: 21787 passed, 23 failed, **all 23 in `scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`, each naming the main-red below** |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` | exit 0: 80 files, 1279 tests |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test` (unit **and** integration projects) | exit 0: 501 files, 6297 tests |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (the `(narrowing)` arm's full battery) | exit 0: 295 files, 2520 tests |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` (pre-merge head `80ed3baba1`) | exit 0: 263 files, 21485 tests |
| plugin-audit `sys-comment-retired-fields.test.ts`, service-automation `decision-overlapping-edge-conditions.pin.test.ts` (both read the ledger; pre-merge) | exit 0 each |
| `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` | exit 0: no checklist anchor in the change set |

**Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3e7b204be7`: 120 families. Every one run; `--ran` reconciles: "120 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 120 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". 118 exit 0, including `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:llms-txt`, `check:quick-reference-counts`, `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:nul-bytes`. Two are red, both the main-red below: `check:liveness` and `check:generated` (whose only stale artifact is `liveness/state-counts/`).

**Main-red, not this PR's.** `check:liveness` refuses `translation/flows.screens → packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: the citation names a file that no longer names the property. Reproduced on a clean `origin/main` `c61f75d10f` worktree (exit 1, same line). The service-automation refactors that moved bodies out of `engine.ts` (#25725, #25734) moved `renderFlowTextSlot` to `packages/services/service-automation/src/node-text-rendering.ts`. The proposed patch, not carried here because it is outside this diff: in `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`, re-point that row's `engine.ts#renderFlowTextSlot` evidence to `node-text-rendering.ts#renderFlowTextSlot`. No fix PR existed to port when this was measured.

**Ablation (reverse verification of the pin).** The pin imports `src`, so there is no `dist/` leg. Through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree, I replaced the retirement comment in `src/kernel/index.ts` with `export * from './package-upgrade.zod';` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `baf1437875cf` → `cc18be2f5671`) and restored the module from the base under an EXIT trap. Predicted red: runtime namespaces, module-on-disk / importer, and the tree-scoped walk. Predicted green: export-origin holders (they read the committed artifact), shards, registration, the contract type and the `plan` shape. **Observed exactly that: 3 red, 7 green.** The restore was blob-identical to `HEAD` (`baf1437875cf`), `git diff HEAD` was empty, and the restored module was deleted. A first attempt was a recorded no-op (its replacement kept the anchor, so the tool refused it) and is not counted.

**Downstream.** objectui main `a3c0da9` / pin `2958f17e9c`, and hotcrm `a4b3560`: zero hits (table above). No objectui fix or pin bump is needed.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx` § Upgrades describes `objectstack upgrade` strategies and pre-upgrade backups as design intent, flagged as such at the top of the page; it never cited the retired spec and this diff does not make it false. Not touched.
- `PackageUpgradeRequestSchema` / `PackageUpgradeResponseSchema` stay published and bound to no route (recorded by the existing D3 entry `package-api-contracts-unmounted-entries-retired`); retiring them is outside this card.
- The D3 entry `change-management-family-retired` (history) still says `kernel/MetadataChangeType` was "a different declaration with a live consumer" and "unaffected". That was true of that retirement; its only reader was the module retired here. Left as history.
